findings.title: Materials' 124 percent growth bet
findings.body: Materials sits at the 29th percentile forward but the 91st percentile trailing, a 62-point gap that is the widest in the table. The market is underwriting 124 percent earnings growth, which would be a historic re-rating for a sector that has not yet shown it can deliver.

findings.title: Health Care's one-week valuation collapse
findings.body: Health Care's forward percentile dropped 34 points in a single week, the largest weekly move anywhere, yet its trailing percentile only fell to 73. The forward multiple now implies 77 percent earnings growth, a bet that margins expand dramatically from a level the trailing lens still prices as rich.

findings.title: Consumer Staples' extreme lens divergence
findings.body: Consumer Staples trades at the 46th percentile forward but the 90th percentile trailing, a 45-point gap that rivals Materials'. The market is pricing 51 percent earnings growth, yet the trailing multiple remains near a five-year high, suggesting the compression is a forecast, not a fact.
